notes.title: Meet sCATter during the Steam Autumn Sale 2019
notes.content:
Hello friends and neighbors!
I'm here with news of the new sCATter!

For those of you who haven't met the sCATter on Halloween.
sCATter also visited us on the Steam Autumn Sale 2019

In addition to the sale, we have new information and updates that you're waiting for.
I'm coming back, so please wait a little longer!

Well, I hope you have a good  Steam Autumn Sale 2019. ^_^/

P.S. Make sure you don't get cold!

notes.title: Special updates and Sale on Halloween
notes.content:
Hello!
It's October with Halloween, for those of you who enjoy sCATter!

For Halloween, the scATter has been remodeled, too! (ノ◕ヮ◕)ノ*:･ﾟ✧
Also, for Halloween, we have a sale so that more people can enjoy the sCATter!
Let's beat the angry cats with the spooky Halloween theme!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323129/5f3f619cfcbb406a447f55031d2d5532c143e1b7.png[/img]

A new Halloween song 'Pumpkin Jumpin' has been added with a new theme update.
In addition, there's one more familiar classical music that you liked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323129/3b713af3e7f2c72b6869ad3c573e1a03362cf0ad.png[/img]

The sCATter team also participated in the Busan Indie Game Festival in Korea.
I had a great opportunity to meet you all.

Thanks to the users who always support us, I think it's a driving force for us to work harder ᕙ(⇀‸↼‶)ᕗ

Lastly, I have a piece of Artwork to celebrate Halloween for you who love sCATter.
I would appreciate it if you continue to love me!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323129/8b7e9c12aa40b0d4996815185734732029a65493.jpg[/img]


Mail. contact@seedgames.co.kr
Twitter. @SEEDGAMES_

notes.title: UPDATE NEWS - 2019. 06. 25.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323129/e5de27f56aa4f74dbc873b56a447e019a7827974.png[/img]

Hello! 

Thank you all for waiting a long time.
A large update was made on June 25, 2019, at 3:00 a.m. (GMT+9).


Update Note:

- Reorganize the overall game UI
- Add new play maps
- Added note strike sound selection (four things)
- Reorganization of steam achievements
- Add four new songs

[list]
[*] Blackmoor Ninjas [b]by MatthewPablo [/b]
[*] Canon Kim [b]by DB. KIM.[/b]
[*] Extreme [b]by StudioKolomna[/b]
[*] Still Alive [b]by Progressive knowledge[/b]
[/list]

- Difficulties that were divided into EASY, ADV, and HARD are subdivided into EASY, ADV, HARD, HYPER, EXTRA

- Add background video of some songs

Other Patches

- Changed album art for some songs
- Modifying the overall pattern difficulty plot
- Frame optimization and visual effects modification


I'm still working on additional songs and I'll try to update them as soon as possible.

Thank you.

notes.title: Leaderboards and Achievements Reset Announcement (1)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323129/26254a7e337dd637e94e434d8e592a7313d6caf1.png[/img]

Hi, everyone.

I want to give you a simple but important announcement.

First, the update that was scheduled to take place in May. 
Let me tell you a sad story about the delay until the middle of June.

The update is almost complete. 
It was delayed due to issues such as later work. 

Please understand me a lot.

The second thing I'm going to deliver is that the Achievements and Leaderboards will be initialized prior to the next big update.

Initialization of the challenge will take place at 2019-06. 10. 00:00 (KST).
The Leaderboards will be initialized at the same time as the next update.

We hope you'll look forward to a big update soon!

notes.title: New Update Notice!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323129/582de071456c400edb10422040e387d4d33a530c.png[/img]

[h1]Hello, sCATter Development Team![/h1]
I will apologize for not sharing much information during the early access period.

What I'm going to tell you is that I'm going to notify you about the details of future updates that I've heard a lot about you.

First, the following updates will be updated with updates to be made in late May!

so that we can enjoy our new songs.
[b]1. Add 10 new songs from various genres[/b]

Easier to access and more legible.
[b]2. Reorganization of UI[/b]

It's easier to hit.
[b]3. Improve Note Response[/b]

More fun with different sounds.
[b]4. Adding a note strike tone change feature[/b]

Don't get stuck on any computer.
[b]5. Frame improvement and optimization[/b]

For those of you who want more and more.
[b]6. Adding a lot of steam achievements[/b]

In addition, development teams are trying to add many improvements!

As the update is just around the corner, we'll try not to disappoint you!
If you have any questions, please send me an e-mail to [b]contact@seedgames.co.kr[/b] and I will reply to you.

Well, let's meet up with the next news!

notes.title: Update Version 1.1.5 : February 22, 2019
notes.content:
Hello, We are SEEDGAMES.

On 22 February 2019, we performed an update of 1.1.5 (GMT +09:00 ) .
The modifications are as follows:


[b]-- Version 1.1.5[/b]

[list]
[*] Add : Added score ranking table by songs.
[*] Add: When selecting a song, you can also see the best combo.
[*] Fix: Level of some patterns have been modified.
[*] - Point Driver Easy, Dinner Time Easy, Adios Dream Travel Easy → Level 1
[*] Fix: Corrected a typing error of song titles
[*] - One Day Dreaming (ft. Woohit) → One Day Dreaming (ft. Wooohit)
[*] Fix : Problem that the trigger pressure change in the setting did not working properly has been corrected
[*] Fix : Some UI of the setting has been modified.
[*] Fix : The setting of the music volume in the settings has been corrected for a problem that is not working properly.
[*] Fix : Fixed an issue that MISS judgment's score was not counted properly.
[/list]

Due to the addition of ranking table, all players score has been reset.

UI improvement and custom song support are currently being prepared.
With your support for Early Access, we've prepared a lot.

Thank you all the time.

notes.title: Version Update 1.1.2: February 12, 2019
notes.content:
Hello, We are SEEDGAMES.

As noticed, we have performed an update of 1.1.2 on 2019.02.12 (GMT +09:00) 
The improvements are as follows:

[b]-- Version 1.1.2[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix: The bug that the chord note is not recognized properly depending on the location of the controller has been modified.
[*] Fix: Improved music and sound effects.
[*] Fix: The bug that the ALL SONG achievement is not handled has been modified.
[*] Fix: The bug that couldn't treated when Excellent in the 'Dive to Light' song is modified.
[*] Fix: The range and location of the notes have been modified.
[*] Fix: We changed Rank display from S+ to EXC.
[*] Add: We added a new song. (NewWind)
[*] Add : UI improvement. (HIGHRANK, FULL COMBO EFFECT, Song's length, etc.)
[*] Add: 'How To Play' can be highlighted when the game is first started.
[*] Optimization: Frame optimization was performed within the in-game.
[/list]

Due to the ALL SONG achievement and RANK storage update, previously saved data needs to be recreated. We are sorry.

In the future, we will reward you with continuous improvement and enhanced content.
Thank you.

notes.title: Update Version 1.1.2 : Announcement
notes.content:
Hello!
Thank you for your love of [b]sCATter.[/b]

We are trying to check and reflect all the comments and compliments you send us.

In this notice, we're going to give you a preview of the next patch that will take place soon.

[b]--- Version 1.1.2[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix: The bug that the concurrency note is not recognized properly according to the controller location has been modified.
[*] Fix: Fixed a bug that sounded too loud for music or effects.
[*] Add: Add a new song
[*] Add : UI has been modified.
[*] Add: You can highlight How To Play when you start the game for the first time.
[*] Optimize : There was some frame optimization in the in-game.

[/list]

In addition to the above important points, some bug lights have been modified.

The development team is well aware of all the common problems and suggestions of the players, such as inserting a custom song, making it difficult to check the judgment line.

We will do our best to resolve any inconvenience to our users within a six-month period of early access.

Thank you for your trust and purchase.
